patch_description: This crossover preserves the empirically stronger readout-aligned CRZ layer while retaining the current program’s disjoint-matching edge order. All adaptive gates share one parameter, so the model still has only three total trainable values including gain and bias. The Möbius CZ backbone supplies local and opposite-wire propagation, shared ring ZZ gates process symmetric correlations, and final directional CRZ gates align the transformed state with the dataset’s measured pairs. Reordering commuting ring interactions into matchings preserves the functional circuit of the stronger prior candidate while exposing more parallelism and reducing unnecessary depth.
